/quality/ncrs/4.issueDescription: Hardness below specification on 6 pieces after quench and temper.
/quality/ncrs/4.containmentAction: All suspect stock quarantined and tagged; 100% sorting of the affected lots started.

/quality/ncrs/2.issueDescription: Chatter marks found on journal surfaces during in-process audit.
/quality/ncrs/2.containmentAction: All suspect stock quarantined and tagged; 100% sorting of the affected lots started.
/quality/ncrs/2.rootCause: 5-why analysis: worn tooling and an unmonitored process parameter allowed the drift to reach the customer lot.
/quality/ncrs/2.correctiveAction: Worn tooling replaced, process re-validated, three consecutive lots passed with zero findings.
/quality/ncrs/2.preventiveAction: Tool-life counters and SPC alarms rolled out to all similar machining lines.

capaActions.actionDescription: Replace the worn tool and re-validate the first-off piece.
